blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for commercial contract work — NDA and agreement review, amendments, renewals, escalation, and stakeholder summaries. Each prompt runs on its own; the review workflows offer a provisional mode if you have not built a Practice Profile. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: Commercial Contracts — House Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview capturing how your contracts team works — playbook, escalation, deal-breakers — into a reusable Commercial Practice Profile. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: Triage an NDA
prompts.description: Sort one inbound NDA into Green / Yellow / Red against your team's playbook.

prompts.title: Review a Vendor Agreement
prompts.description: Review one inbound vendor agreement against your playbook — memo, redlines, two-axis severity, and a named approver.

prompts.title: Review a SaaS / Subscription Agreement
prompts.description: Review a SaaS agreement with an overlay for auto-renewal, price escalation, data exit, SLAs, subprocessors, and AI / ML training rights.

prompts.title: Trace Amendments
prompts.description: Read a base agreement and its amendments — summarise what changed, or trace one provision to its current controlling language.

prompts.title: Track Renewal Deadlines
prompts.description: Read a renewal register and produce an urgency-banded rollup, a missed-windows report, or a refreshed register row.

prompts.title: Route a Contract Issue for Approval
prompts.description: Match one contract issue against your escalation matrix, name the approver, and draft the ask. Needs a Commercial Practice Profile.

prompts.title: Summarise a Review for the Business
prompts.description: Turn a completed review memo into a two-minute, non-legal summary for the business owner who asked for the contract.
